info.name: Cleanora R1-P04 Customer Self-Service
info.description: Executable R1-P04 customer self-service collection with explicit Hosted and Local folders. Every request includes a saved Success example; requests with bodies also include a commented Sample of correct body. Run the matching R1-P02 login flow first so accessToken is available. Use an ACTIVE customer with the required verified category and consult Swagger for complete error contracts. Profile-image upload uses a local JPEG/PNG/WebP file and never exports Cloudinary credentials.

request.description: Preferred frontend bootstrap read for the customer profile screen. Returns customer category state, every verified category profile, profile image, contact state, preferences, and addresses in one response. It does not select a primary category; continue using the resource-specific APIs for writes.

response.name: Success
